```elixir
defmodule AlphaFold3Gateway.Application do
  use Application
  require Logger

  @impl true
  def start(_type, _args) do
    children = [
      {Phoenix.PubSub, name: AlphaFold3Gateway.PubSub},
      AlphaFold3GatewayWeb.Telemetry,
      {Cachex, name: :gateway_cache},
      {AlphaFold3Gateway.BackendPool, name: :julia_backend_pool, backend: :julia_backend},
      {AlphaFold3Gateway.BackendPool, name: :python_backend_pool, backend: :python_backend},
      AlphaFold3Gateway.RateLimiter,
      AlphaFold3Gateway.MetricsCollector,
      AlphaFold3GatewayWeb.Endpoint
    ]

    opts = [strategy: :one_for_one, name: AlphaFold3Gateway.Supervisor]
    Logger.info("🚀 AlphaFold3 Gateway starting on port 4000")
    Supervisor.start_link(children, opts)
  end

  @impl true
  def config_change(changed, _new, removed) do
    AlphaFold3GatewayWeb.Endpoint.config_change(changed, removed)
    :ok
  end
end
```

```elixir
defmodule AlphaFold3Gateway.BackendPool do
  use GenServer
  require Logger

  def start_link(opts) do
    name = Keyword.fetch!(opts, :name)
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: name)
  end

  @impl true
  def init(opts) do
    backend = Keyword.fetch!(opts, :backend)
    config = Application.get_env(:alphafold3_gateway, :backends)[backend]
    
    pool_config = [
      name: {:local, :"#{backend}_pool"},
      worker_module: AlphaFold3Gateway.BackendWorker,
      size: config[:pool_size] || 10,
      max_overflow: 5
    ]

    :poolboy.start_link(pool_config, config)
    
    state = %{
      backend: backend,
      config: config,
      pool_name: :"#{backend}_pool"
    }

    Logger.info("✅ Backend pool started for #{backend}")
    {:ok, state}
  end

  def execute(pool_name, fun) do
    :poolboy.transaction(pool_name, fun)
  end
end
```

### 8. `lib/alphafold3_gateway/backend_worker.ex`

```elixir
defmodule AlphaFold3Gateway.BackendWorker do
  use GenServer
  require Logger

  def start_link(config) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, config)
  end

  @impl true
  def init(config) do
    {:ok, config}
  end

  def make_request(worker, method, path, body, headers) do
    GenServer.call(worker, {:request, method, path, body, headers}, :infinity)
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:request, method, path, body, headers}, _from, config) do
    url = build_url(config, path)
    
    result = case method do
      :get -> HTTPoison.get(url, headers, [recv_timeout: config[:timeout]])
      :post -> HTTPoison.post(url, body, headers, [recv_timeout: config[:timeout]])
      :put -> HTTPoison.put(url, body, headers, [recv_timeout: config[:timeout]])
      :delete -> HTTPoison.delete(url, headers, [recv_timeout: config[:timeout]])
      :patch -> HTTPoison.patch(url, body, headers, [recv_timeout: config[:timeout]])
    end

    {:reply, result, config}
  end

  defp build_url(config, path) do
    protocol = config[:protocol]
    host = config[:host]
    port = config[:port]
    "#{protocol}://#{host}:#{port}#{path}"
  end
end
```

### 9. `lib/alphafold3_gateway/rate_limiter.ex`

```elixir
defmodule AlphaFold3Gateway.RateLimiter do
  use GenServer
  require Logger

  def start_link(_opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{}, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  @impl true
  def init(_) do
    config = Application.get_env(:alphafold3_gateway, :rate_limiting)
    state = %{
      enabled: config[:enabled],
      requests_per_minute: config[:requests_per_minute],
      burst_size: config[:burst_size],
      buckets: %{}
    }
    {:ok, state}
  end

  def check_rate_limit(client_ip) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:check_rate_limit, client_ip})
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:check_rate_limit, client_ip}, _from, state) do
    if state.enabled do
      now = System.system_time(:second)
      bucket = Map.get(state.buckets, client_ip, %{tokens: state.burst_size, last_update: now})
      
      time_passed = now - bucket.last_update
      tokens_to_add = time_passed * (state.requests_per_minute / 60.0)
      new_tokens = min(bucket.tokens + tokens_to_add, state.burst_size)
      
      if new_tokens >= 1.0 do
        new_bucket = %{tokens: new_tokens - 1.0, last_update: now}
        new_buckets = Map.put(state.buckets, client_ip, new_bucket)
        {:reply, :ok, %{state | buckets: new_buckets}}
      else
        {:reply, {:error, :rate_limited}, state}
      end
    else
      {:reply, :ok, state}
    end
  end
end
```

```elixir
defmodule AlphaFold3Gateway.MetricsCollector do
  use GenServer
  require Logger

  def start_link(_opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{}, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  @impl true
  def init(_) do
    state = %{
      requests: 0,
      successful_requests: 0,
      failed_requests: 0,
      total_latency: 0,
      backend_latencies: %{}
    }
    {:ok, state}
  end

  def record_request(backend, latency, success) do
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:record, backend, latency, success})
  end

  def get_metrics do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :get_metrics)
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:record, backend, latency, success}, state) do
    new_state = state
    |> Map.update!(:requests, &(&1 + 1))
    |> Map.update!(if(success, do: :successful_requests, else: :failed_requests), &(&1 + 1))
    |> Map.update!(:total_latency, &(&1 + latency))
    |> Map.update(:backend_latencies, %{}, fn latencies ->
      Map.update(latencies, backend, [latency], &([latency | &1]))
    end)

    {:noreply, new_state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call(:get_metrics, _from, state) do
    avg_latency = if state.requests > 0, do: state.total_latency / state.requests, else: 0
    
    metrics = %{
      total_requests: state.requests,
      successful_requests: state.successful_requests,
      failed_requests: state.failed_requests,
      average_latency_ms: avg_latency,
      backend_latencies: state.backend_latencies
    }

    {:reply, metrics, state}
  end
end
```

### 13. `lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/controllers/proxy_controller.ex`

```elixir
defmodule AlphaFold3GatewayWeb.ProxyController do
  use AlphaFold3GatewayWeb, :controller
  require Logger

  def julia_backend(conn, %{"path" => path}) do
    proxy_request(conn, :julia_backend, path)
  end

  def python_backend(conn, %{"path" => path}) do
    proxy_request(conn, :python_backend, path)
  end

  defp proxy_request(conn, backend, path) do
    start_time = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    
    method = String.downcase(conn.method) |> String.to_atom()
    full_path = "/" <> Enum.join(path, "/")
    full_path = if conn.query_string != "", do: "#{full_path}?#{conn.query_string}", else: full_path
    
    {:ok, body, conn} = Plug.Conn.read_body(conn)
    
    headers = conn.req_headers
    |> Enum.filter(fn {k, _v} -> k not in ["host", "connection"] end)
    |> Enum.into([])

    pool_name = :"#{backend}_pool"
    
    result = :poolboy.transaction(pool_name, fn worker ->
      AlphaFold3Gateway.BackendWorker.make_request(worker, method, full_path, body, headers)
    end)

    latency = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) - start_time

    case result do
      {:ok, %HTTPoison.Response{status_code: status, headers: resp_headers, body: resp_body}} ->
        AlphaFold3Gateway.MetricsCollector.record_request(backend, latency, true)
        Logger.info("✅ #{backend} request successful: #{method} #{full_path} (#{latency}ms)")
        
        conn
        |> put_resp_headers(resp_headers)
        |> send_resp(status, resp_body)

      {:error, %HTTPoison.Error{reason: reason}} ->
        AlphaFold3Gateway.MetricsCollector.record_request(backend, latency, false)
        Logger.error("❌ #{backend} request failed: #{inspect(reason)}")
        
        conn
        |> put_status(:bad_gateway)
        |> json(%{error: "Backend service unavailable", reason: inspect(reason)})
    end
  end

  defp put_resp_headers(conn, headers) do
    Enum.reduce(headers, conn, fn {key, value}, acc ->
      if key not in ["transfer-encoding", "connection"] do
        put_resp_header(acc, key, value)
      else
        acc
      end
    end)
  end
end
```

### 14. `lib/alphafold3_gateway_web/controllers/prediction_controller.ex`

```elixir
defmodule AlphaFold3GatewayWeb.PredictionController do
  use AlphaFold3GatewayWeb, :controller
  require Logger

  def predict(conn, params) do
    case validate_prediction_params(params) do
      :ok ->
        job_id = generate_job_id()
        
        Task.start(fn ->
          process_prediction(job_id, params)
        end)

        conn
        |> put_status(:accepted)
        |> json(%{
          job_id: job_id,
          status: "queued",
          message: "Prediction job submitted successfully"
        })

      {:error, reason} ->
        conn
        |> put_status(:bad_request)
        |> json(%{error: reason})
    end
  end

  def batch_predict(conn, %{"predictions" => predictions}) when is_list(predictions) do
    job_ids = Enum.map(predictions, fn pred ->
      job_id = generate_job_id()
      
      Task.start(fn ->
        process_prediction(job_id, pred)
      end)

      job_id
    end)

    conn
    |> put_status(:accepted)
    |> json(%{
      job_ids: job_ids,
      status: "queued",
      message: "Batch prediction jobs submitted successfully"
    })
  end

  def get_status(conn, %{"job_id" => job_id}) do
    case Cachex.get(:gateway_cache, "job:#{job_id}") do
      {:ok, nil} ->
        conn
        |> put_status(:not_found)
        |> json(%{error: "Job not found"})

      {:ok, job_data} ->
        conn
        |> json(job_data)
    end
  end

  defp process_prediction(job_id, params) do
    Cachex.put(:gateway_cache, "job:#{job_id}", %{
      job_id: job_id,
      status: "processing",
      started_at: DateTime.utc_now()
    })

    result = :poolboy.transaction(:julia_backend_pool, fn worker ->
      body = Jason.encode!(params)
      headers = [{"content-type", "application/json"}]
      AlphaFold3Gateway.BackendWorker.make_request(worker, :post, "/api/predict", body, headers)
    end)

    case result do
      {:ok, %HTTPoison.Response{status_code: 200, body: response_body}} ->
        parsed_result = Jason.decode!(response_body)
        
        Cachex.put(:gateway_cache, "job:#{job_id}", %{
          job_id: job_id,
          status: "completed",
          result: parsed_result,
          completed_at: DateTime.utc_now()
        })

        Phoenix.PubSub.broadcast(
          AlphaFold3Gateway.PubSub,
          "job:#{job_id}",
          {:job_completed, job_id, parsed_result}
        )

      {:error, reason} ->
        Cachex.put(:gateway_cache, "job:#{job_id}", %{
          job_id: job_id,
          status: "failed",
          error: inspect(reason),
          failed_at: DateTime.utc_now()
        })

        Phoenix.PubSub.broadcast(
          AlphaFold3Gateway.PubSub,
          "job:#{job_id}",
          {:job_failed, job_id, inspect(reason)}
        )
    end
  end

  defp validate_prediction_params(params) do
    required_fields = ["protein_sequence"]
    
    case Enum.find(required_fields, fn field -> !Map.has_key?(params, field) end) do
      nil -> :ok
      missing_field -> {:error, "Missing required field: #{missing_field}"}
    end
  end

  defp generate_job_id do
    "job_" <> (:crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16) |> Base.url_encode64(padding: false))
  end
end
```

```elixir
defmodule AlphaFold3GatewayWeb.HealthController do
  use AlphaFold3GatewayWeb, :controller
  require Logger

  def check(conn, _params) do
    backends_status = %{
      julia: check_backend_health(:julia_backend),
      python: check_backend_health(:python_backend)
    }

    all_healthy = Enum.all?(Map.values(backends_status), &(&1 == :healthy))

    status = if all_healthy, do: :ok, else: :service_unavailable

    conn
    |> put_status(status)
    |> json(%{
      status: if(all_healthy, do: "healthy", else: "unhealthy"),
      timestamp: DateTime.utc_now(),
      backends: backends_status,
      uptime: get_uptime()
    })
  end

  defp check_backend_health(backend) do
    pool_name = :"#{backend}_pool"
    
    try do
      result = :poolboy.transaction(pool_name, fn worker ->
        AlphaFold3Gateway.BackendWorker.make_request(worker, :get, "/health", "", [])
      end, 5000)

      case result do
        {:ok, %HTTPoison.Response{status_code: 200}} -> :healthy
        _ -> :unhealthy
      end
    rescue
      _ -> :unhealthy
    end
  end

  defp get_uptime do
    {uptime_ms, _} = :erlang.statistics(:wall_clock)
    uptime_ms / 1000
  end
end
```

```elixir
defmodule AlphaFold3GatewayWeb.Plugs.RateLimitPlug do
  import Plug.Conn
  require Logger

  def init(opts), do: opts

  def call(conn, _opts) do
    client_ip = get_client_ip(conn)

    case AlphaFold3Gateway.RateLimiter.check_rate_limit(client_ip) do
      :ok ->
        conn

      {:error, :rate_limited} ->
        Logger.warn("Rate limit exceeded for IP: #{inspect(client_ip)}")
        
        conn
        |> put_status(:too_many_requests)
        |> Phoenix.Controller.json(%{error: "Rate limit exceeded"})
        |> halt()
    end
  end

  defp get_client_ip(conn) do
    case get_req_header(conn, "x-forwarded-for") do
      [ip | _] -> ip
      [] -> to_string(:inet.ntoa(conn.remote_ip))
    end
  end
end
```

```elixir
defmodule AlphaFold3GatewayWeb.Plugs.MetricsPlug do
  import Plug.Conn
  require Logger

  def init(opts), do: opts

  def call(conn, _opts) do
    start_time = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)

    Plug.Conn.register_before_send(conn, fn conn ->
      latency = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) - start_time
      Logger.info("Request completed in #{latency}ms: #{conn.method} #{conn.request_path}")
      conn
    end)
  end
end
```

```elixir
defmodule AlphaFold3GatewayWeb.JobChannel do
  use Phoenix.Channel
  require Logger

  @impl true
  def join("job:" <> job_id, _payload, socket) do
    Logger.info("Client joined job channel: #{job_id}")
    
    Phoenix.PubSub.subscribe(AlphaFold3Gateway.PubSub, "job:#{job_id}")
    
    case Cachex.get(:gateway_cache, "job:#{job_id}") do
      {:ok, nil} ->
        {:ok, %{status: "not_found"}, assign(socket, :job_id, job_id)}
      
      {:ok, job_data} ->
        {:ok, job_data, assign(socket, :job_id, job_id)}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info({:job_completed, job_id, result}, socket) do
    push(socket, "job_completed", %{job_id: job_id, result: result})
    {:noreply, socket}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info({:job_failed, job_id, error}, socket) do
    push(socket, "job_failed", %{job_id: job_id, error: error})
    {:noreply, socket}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info({:job_progress, job_id, progress}, socket) do
    push(socket, "job_progress", %{job_id: job_id, progress: progress})
    {:noreply, socket}
  end
end
```

```html
        // API Gateway Configuration
        const API_BASE_URL = '';
        const WS_URL = 'ws://localhost:4000/socket';
        
        let socket = null;
        let jobChannel = null;
        let currentJobId = null;

        // WebSocket Connection
        function initializeWebSocket() {
            const socketProtocol = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';
            const socketUrl = `${socketProtocol}//${window.location.hostname}:4000/socket`;
            
            socket = new Phoenix.Socket(socketUrl, {
                params: {user_id: generateUserId()},
                logger: (kind, msg, data) => {
                    console.log(`${kind}: ${msg}`, data);
                }
            });

            socket.onOpen(() => {
                updateConnectionStatus(true);
                addLog('WebSocket kapcsolat létrehozva');
            });

            socket.onClose(() => {
                updateConnectionStatus(false);
                addLog('WebSocket kapcsolat megszakadt');
                setTimeout(initializeWebSocket, 3000);
            });

            socket.onError((error) => {
                console.error('WebSocket hiba:', error);
                addLog('WebSocket hiba: ' + error, 'error');
            });

            socket.connect();
        }

        function generateUserId() {
            return 'user_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 15);
        }

        function updateConnectionStatus(connected) {
            const dot = document.getElementById('connectionDot');
            const text = document.getElementById('connectionText');
            
            if (connected) {
                dot.className = 'connection-dot connected';
                text.textContent = 'Kapcsolódva';
            } else {
                dot.className = 'connection-dot disconnected';
                text.textContent = 'Lekapcsolva';
            }
        }

        // Sequence Analysis
        document.getElementById('proteinSequence').addEventListener('input', function(e) {
            const sequence = e.target.value;
            analyzeSequence(sequence);
        });

        function analyzeSequence(sequence) {
            const cleaned = sequence.replace(/[>\s\d]/g, '').replace(/^[^A-Z]+/gm, '');
            const chains = sequence.split('>').filter(s => s.trim()).length;
            
            document.getElementById('seqLength').textContent = cleaned.length;
            document.getElementById('chainCount').textContent = chains || 1;
            
            const validAminoAcids = /^[ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY]+$/i;
            const isValid = cleaned.length > 0 && validAminoAcids.test(cleaned);
            
            const validityEl = document.getElementById('validity');
            validityEl.textContent = isValid ? '✓ Érvényes' : '✗ Érvénytelen';
            validityEl.style.color = isValid ? '#48bb78' : '#f56565';
        }

        // File Upload
        document.getElementById('fileUpload').addEventListener('change', function(e) {
            const file = e.target.files[0];
            if (!file) return;

            const reader = new FileReader();
            reader.onload = function(event) {
                document.getElementById('proteinSequence').value = event.target.result;
                analyzeSequence(event.target.result);
                addLog(`Fájl betöltve: ${file.name}`);
            };
            reader.readAsText(file);
        });

        // Prediction Start
        async function startPrediction() {
            const sequence = document.getElementById('proteinSequence').value.trim();
            
            if (!sequence) {
                alert('Kérem adjon meg egy fehérje szekvenciát!');
                return;
            }

            const btn = document.getElementById('predictBtn');
            btn.disabled = true;
            btn.textContent = '🔄 Feldolgozás...';

            updateStatus('processing', 'Predikció indítása...');
            addLog('Predikció kérés küldése a gateway-nek...');

            try {
                const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/api/predict`, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        protein_sequence: sequence,
                        model: 'alphafold3',
                        use_quantum_enhancement: true
                    })
                });

                if (!response.ok) {
                    throw new Error(`HTTP hiba! státusz: ${response.status}`);
                }

                const data = await response.json();
                currentJobId = data.job_id;
                
                document.getElementById('jobId').textContent = currentJobId;
                document.getElementById('startTime').textContent = new Date().toLocaleString('hu-HU');
                document.getElementById('jobInfo').style.display = 'block';

                addLog(`Job létrehozva: ${currentJobId}`);
                
                subscribeToJob(currentJobId);
                startProgressSimulation();

            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Hiba:', error);
                addLog(`Hiba: ${error.message}`, 'error');
                updateStatus('error', 'Hiba történt!');
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.textContent = '🚀 Predikció Indítása';
            }
        }

        function subscribeToJob(jobId) {
            if (!socket || !socket.isConnected()) {
                addLog('Várakozás a WebSocket kapcsolatra...', 'warning');
                setTimeout(() => subscribeToJob(jobId), 1000);
                return;
            }

            jobChannel = socket.channel(`job:${jobId}`, {});
            
            jobChannel.join()
                .receive('ok', (response) => {
                    addLog(`Csatlakozva a job channelhez: ${jobId}`);
                    console.log('Job channel csatlakozva:', response);
                })
                .receive('error', (response) => {
                    addLog(`Hiba a channel csatlakozáskor: ${response.reason}`, 'error');
                    console.error('Channel csatlakozási hiba:', response);
                });

            jobChannel.on('job_progress', (payload) => {
                addLog(`Előrehaladás: ${payload.progress}%`);
                updateProgress(payload.progress);
            });

            jobChannel.on('job_completed', (payload) => {
                addLog('Predikció sikeresen befejezve! ✓');
                handleJobCompletion(payload.result);
            });

            jobChannel.on('job_failed', (payload) => {
                addLog(`Predikció sikertelen: ${payload.error}`, 'error');
                updateStatus('error', 'Predikció sikertelen');
                document.getElementById('predictBtn').disabled = false;
                document.getElementById('predictBtn').textContent = '🚀 Predikció Indítása';
            });
        }

        function startProgressSimulation() {
            let progress = 0;
            const interval = setInterval(() => {
                progress += Math.random() * 5;
                if (progress >= 95) {
                    progress = 95;
                    clearInterval(interval);
                }
                updateProgress(progress);
            }, 1000);
        }

        function updateProgress(percent) {
            const progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
            progressBar.style.width = `${percent}%`;
            progressBar.textContent = `${Math.round(percent)}%`;
        }

        function handleJobCompletion(result) {
            updateProgress(100);
            updateStatus('idle', 'Predikció befejezve! ✓');
            
            document.getElementById('resultsGrid').style.display = 'grid';
            document.getElementById('visualizationPanel').style.display = 'block';

            if (result.plddt_score) {
                document.getElementById('plddtScore').textContent = result.plddt_score.toFixed(2);
            }
            if (result.tm_score) {
                document.getElementById('tmScore').textContent = result.tm_score.toFixed(2);
            }
            if (result.rmsd) {
                document.getElementById('rmsdValue').textContent = result.rmsd.toFixed(2) + ' Å';
            }
            if (result.processing_time_ms) {
                document.getElementById('processingTime').textContent = (result.processing_time_ms / 1000).toFixed(2) + ' s';
            }
            
            document.getElementById('backendUsed').textContent = result.backend || 'Julia + Python';

            const btn = document.getElementById('predictBtn');
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = '🚀 Újabb Predikció';

            addLog('Eredmények megjelenítve');
        }

        function updateStatus(status, text) {
            const dot = document.getElementById('statusDot');
            const statusText = document.getElementById('statusText');
            
            dot.className = `status-dot ${status}`;
            statusText.textContent = text;
        }

        function addLog(message, type = 'info') {
            const logPanel = document.getElementById('logPanel');
            const timestamp = new Date().toLocaleTimeString('hu-HU');
            
            const entry = document.createElement('div');
            entry.className = 'log-entry';
            entry.innerHTML = `
                <span class="log-timestamp">[${timestamp}]</span>
                <span class="log-message">${message}</span>
            `;
            
            logPanel.appendChild(entry);
            logPanel.scrollTop = logPanel.scrollHeight;
        }

        // Phoenix Socket Library (inline for simplicity)
        class Phoenix {
            static Socket = class {
                constructor(url, opts = {}) {
                    this.endPoint = url;
                    this.opts = opts;
                    this.channels = [];
                    this.sendBuffer = [];
                    this.ref = 0;
                    this.timeout = opts.timeout || 10000;
                    this.heartbeatIntervalMs = opts.heartbeatIntervalMs || 30000;
                    this.reconnectAfterMs = opts.reconnectAfterMs || [1000, 2000, 5000, 10000];
                    this.logger = opts.logger || function() {};
                    this.params = opts.params || {};
                }

                connect() {
                    this.conn = new WebSocket(this.endPoint + '?' + this.serializeParams(this.params));
                    
                    this.conn.onopen = () => {
                        this.logger('transport', 'connected', {});
                        this.onConnOpen();
                        if (this.opts.onOpen) this.opts.onOpen();
                    };

                    this.conn.onclose = (event) => {
                        this.logger('transport', 'close', event);
                        this.onConnClose(event);
                        if (this.opts.onClose) this.opts.onClose(event);
                    };

                    this.conn.onerror = (error) => {
                        this.logger('transport', 'error', error);
                        if (this.opts.onError) this.opts.onError(error);
                    };

                    this.conn.onmessage = (event) => {
                        const msg = JSON.parse(event.data);
                        this.channels.forEach(channel => {
                            if (channel.isMember(msg.topic)) {
                                channel.trigger(msg.event, msg.payload, msg.ref);
                            }
                        });
                    };
                }

                onOpen(callback) {
                    this.opts.onOpen = callback;
                }

                onClose(callback) {
                    this.opts.onClose = callback;
                }

                onError(callback) {
                    this.opts.onError = callback;
                }

                channel(topic, params = {}) {
                    const channel = new Phoenix.Channel(topic, params, this);
                    this.channels.push(channel);
                    return channel;
                }

                push(data) {
                    const callback = () => this.conn.send(JSON.stringify(data));
                    if (this.isConnected()) {
                        callback();
                    } else {
                        this.sendBuffer.push(callback);
                    }
                }

                makeRef() {
                    return ++this.ref;
                }

                isConnected() {
                    return this.conn && this.conn.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN;
                }

                onConnOpen() {
                    this.flushSendBuffer();
                    this.reconnectTimer && clearInterval(this.reconnectTimer);
                    this.heartbeatTimer = setInterval(() => this.sendHeartbeat(), this.heartbeatIntervalMs);
                }

                onConnClose() {
                    this.heartbeatTimer && clearInterval(this.heartbeatTimer);
                    this.reconnectTimer = setInterval(() => {
                        this.connect();
                    }, this.reconnectAfterMs[0]);
                }

                sendHeartbeat() {
                    if (!this.isConnected()) return;
                    this.push({
                        topic: 'phoenix',
                        event: 'heartbeat',
                        payload: {},
                        ref: this.makeRef()
                    });
                }

                flushSendBuffer() {
                    if (this.isConnected() && this.sendBuffer.length > 0) {
                        this.sendBuffer.forEach(callback => callback());
                        this.sendBuffer = [];
                    }
                }

                serializeParams(params) {
                    return Object.keys(params).map(key => 
                        `${encodeURIComponent(key)}=${encodeURIComponent(params[key])}`
                    ).join('&');
                }
            }

            static Channel = class {
                constructor(topic, params, socket) {
                    this.topic = topic;
                    this.params = params;
                    this.socket = socket;
                    this.bindings = [];
                    this.state = 'closed';
                    this.joinedOnce = false;
                    this.joinPush = null;
                    this.pushBuffer = [];
                }

                join(timeout = this.socket.timeout) {
                    if (this.joinedOnce) {
                        throw new Error("tried to join multiple times");
                    }
                    this.joinedOnce = true;

                    this.joinPush = new Phoenix.Push(this, 'phx_join', this.params, timeout);

                    return this.joinPush.send();
                }

                on(event, callback) {
                    this.bindings.push({event, callback});
                }

                off(event) {
                    this.bindings = this.bindings.filter(bind => bind.event !== event);
                }

                push(event, payload, timeout = this.socket.timeout) {
                    if (!this.joinedOnce) {
                        throw new Error("tried to push before joining");
                    }

                    const pushEvent = new Phoenix.Push(this, event, payload, timeout);
                    
                    if (this.socket.isConnected()) {
                        pushEvent.send();
                    } else {
                        this.pushBuffer.push(pushEvent);
                    }

                    return pushEvent;
                }

                trigger(event, payload, ref) {
                    this.bindings.filter(bind => bind.event === event)
                        .forEach(bind => bind.callback(payload, ref));
                }

                isMember(topic) {
                    return this.topic === topic;
                }

                leave(timeout = this.socket.timeout) {
                    const leavePush = new Phoenix.Push(this, 'phx_leave', {}, timeout);
                    leavePush.send();
                    return leavePush;
                }
            }

            static Push = class {
                constructor(channel, event, payload, timeout) {
                    this.channel = channel;
                    this.event = event;
                    this.payload = payload;
                    this.timeout = timeout;
                    this.receivedResp = null;
                    this.timeoutTimer = null;
                    this.recHooks = [];
                    this.sent = false;
                }

                send() {
                    this.ref = this.channel.socket.makeRef();
                    this.refEvent = `chan_reply_${this.ref}`;

                    this.channel.on(this.refEvent, (payload) => {
                        this.receivedResp = payload;
                        this.matchReceive(payload);
                    });

                    this.startTimeout();
                    this.sent = true;

                    this.channel.socket.push({
                        topic: this.channel.topic,
                        event: this.event,
                        payload: this.payload,
                        ref: this.ref
                    });

                    return this;
                }

                receive(status, callback) {
                    if (this.receivedResp && this.receivedResp.status === status) {
                        callback(this.receivedResp.response);
                    }

                    this.recHooks.push({status, callback});
                    return this;
                }

                startTimeout() {
                    if (this.timeoutTimer) return;

                    this.timeoutTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                        this.trigger('timeout', {});
                    }, this.timeout);
                }

                trigger(status, response) {
                    this.channel.trigger(this.refEvent, {status, response});
                }

                matchReceive({status, response}) {
                    this.recHooks.filter(h => h.status === status)
                        .forEach(h => h.callback(response));
                }
            }
        }

        // Initialize on page load
        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            initializeWebSocket();
            addLog('AlphaFold3 Gateway Frontend inicializálva');
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```
